data: Which regularization term C value provides the highest accuracy for the model WikiAttack?

The question asks for the regularization term C value that provides the highest accuracy for the model WikiAttack. From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents the regularization term C values ranging from 10^-3 to 10^2. The y-axis represents the accuracy of the models. 

Looking at the graph labeled (a) Accuracy, we can see that the green line (representing WikiAttack) shows the highest accuracy among all the lines. The green line reaches its peak at approximately C = 10^2. Therefore, the regularization term C value that provides the highest accuracy for the model WikiAttack is around 10^2.
